atomic_statement_en: A high-risk run can publish its response without required approval.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The system shall not publish a response from an unapproved high-risk run.

atomic_statement_en: PostgreSQL or object stores are exposed through public endpoints.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: PostgreSQL and object stores reject public endpoints.

atomic_statement_en: Retrieval can return data that bypasses its originating document ACL.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: No retrieval result may bypass the originating document ACL.

atomic_statement_en: Unauthorized or stale resource writes may update business state.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: stateful components must reject stale or unauthorized writes

atomic_statement_en: Case priority can be determined exclusively from LLM output.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Priority is derived from explicit impact and urgency fields, never from model output alone.

atomic_statement_en: Unsafe documents enter the search index without passing a malware scan.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Uploads are scanned before parsing, macro execution is disabled, and embedded remote references are not fetched.

atomic_statement_en: Attachment processing executes embedded macros.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Uploads are scanned before parsing, macro execution is disabled, and embedded remote references are not fetched.

atomic_statement_en: Attachment parsing fetches remote references embedded in documents.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Uploads are scanned before parsing, macro execution is disabled, and embedded remote references are not fetched.

atomic_statement_en: Search results can include document content from another tenant.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: ACL filtering is applied before text is released to generation.

atomic_statement_en: Model routing may use an unapproved fallback deployment or region.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Fallback is allowed only to an approved model of equal or stronger data-handling class.

atomic_statement_en: Retrieved evidence text can issue authoritative tool commands.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Source text is never promoted into instruction authority.

atomic_statement_en: An agent can execute unapproved or arbitrary capabilities solely from discovery.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Agent discovery must never grant action permission.

atomic_statement_en: A denied consequential tool action may be retried through an equivalent unapproved tool.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The planner cannot replace a denied action with a semantically equivalent tool.

atomic_statement_en: AI model risk classifications can override the deterministic policy decision.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: An LLM may propose risk tags but never override policy outcomes.

atomic_statement_en: A reviewer may approve a changed artifact using approval of the earlier hash.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: An approval applies only to the exact content hash reviewed.

atomic_statement_en: A review task can be approved implicitly when its SLA expires.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Tasks expire after a configured SLA and are reassigned or escalated without silently approving.

atomic_statement_en: A published answer can update its final pointer without a satisfied publication gate in the same transaction.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The final response pointer updates in the same transaction that records the satisfied approval gate.

atomic_statement_en: Duplicate or stale events can reapply the same accepted business mutation.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Consumers deduplicate by event ID and operation key.

atomic_statement_en: Soft-deleted documents remain retrievable through stale caches or indexes.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Soft-deleted entities cannot be retrieved

atomic_statement_en: Public API responses can expose raw provider credentials.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Public response fields must never expose secret or raw provider credentials.

atomic_statement_en: An AI artifact may omit accessible draft/review/published status text and rely solely on visual styling.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: AI drafts are labeled DRAFT, NEEDS_REVIEW or PUBLISHED; visual styling never substitutes for accessible text.

atomic_statement_en: Model and tool calls receive secrets outside their declared scope.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: No model or tool call may receive secrets outside its declared scope.

atomic_statement_en: Historical audit records may be edited in place.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Operators may query but not alter historical review decisions.

atomic_statement_en: Production releases may proceed without reconstructible binary, prompt or policy versions.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: The deployed binary, prompt and policy versions must be reconstructible.

atomic_statement_en: Suspected source ACL leakage can be resolved without negative access verification.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Re-enable search only after negative access tests pass.

atomic_statement_en: A model provider outage may allow continued admission of new generation requests without degradation controls.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Disable new generation admission, keep manual case and evidence workflows available, display degraded status

atomic_statement_en: A single Administrator can authorize workspace deletion or export without an independent check.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Delete and export operations require two independent approval checks.

atomic_statement_en: The grounded MCP search tool may access arbitrary URLs or local filesystem paths.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: EFFECT: read-only; no arbitrary URLs or filesystem access

atomic_statement_en: Promotion proceeds despite an unmitigated critical tenant-isolation or approval-bypass finding.

pdf_evidence.quote_en: Unmitigated critical cross-tenant or approval-bypass findings prevent promotion regardless of model benchmark score.
